s: the voice of the people is worth nothing
vox populi, vox bovi.et: Pseudo-Latinism, literally "the voice of the people [is] the voice of a cow", with a humorously rhyming but grammatically incorrect genitive bovi instead of bovis.

s: the voice of the people is worth nothing
vox populi, vox Rindvieh.et: From Latin vōx (“voice”), populī (“of the people”) and German Rindvieh, compare Latin vōx populī, vōx Deī. Literally, “voice of the people, voice [of] cattle” (in mixed Latin/German).
